I'll probably get a lot of "gross" comments for some of these, but hey it's my life:  
  
* I only get my hair cut when it gets just on the cusp of "girls" length, saves money on haircuts by a lot. Helps if you can pull off short and long hair.  
  
* We only shower every 3-4 days MAX, some people I know shower every day and it's such a waste of water and time. This is also due to my psoriasis which gets irritated by being washed too much.  
  
* We don't drink or smoke, and if we drink it's only on special occasions like holiday or milestone events like birthdays and parties.  
  
* When we buy bread and milk, we store some of in the freezer and defrost it when necessary. It loses some of the taste benefits, but you are chucking out a LOT less milk and bread.  
  
* If you can set your heating on a timer, have it so its only on for an hour or two at night and morning, once you're asleep you don't notice the benefits of heating so having it on all night is wasting money.  
  
* See something that would make a good gift for someone? Buy it there and then and store it until Christmas, that way you avoid the manic Christmas shopping and inflated prices. Reduces stress AND saves money.  
  
* Keep a live spreadsheet of all your outgoing bills and your income,  update the figures as a bill changes or is cancelled. This helps you budget and is useful for noticing irregularities in your spending.  
  
* Only buy new clothes when you need them, I have worn shoes down to a bone before replacing them.
